item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"2b71c8d1301577bd8c21-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容說明網路跳板與 SOCKS 代理；略過憑證驗證的範例並非安裝代理 CA 或設定 TLS 信任。","evidence":"Metasploit can launch a SOCKS proxy server using the module: auxiliary/server/socks_proxy ."},{"decision_id":"946eedea9eed683655ae-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確解釋 SYN 掃描如何依 SYN/ACK 或 RST 回應判斷連接埠狀態。","evidence":"The target machine will respond with a SYN/ACK (session request acknowledgment) packet if the port is open, and RST (reset) if the port is closed."},{"decision_id":"98e42863fb7e4f5db70d-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容是利用殭屍主機進行閒置掃描，未提供依指定 IP 篩選已擷取封包的方法。","evidence":"Fundamentally, an idle scan consists of three steps that are repeated for each port:"},{"decision_id":"a127bcb17bf42194df67-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"明確記載 Frida Go API 可附加至應用程式或程序，符合所需的附加能力。","evidence":"Attaching to applications/processes"},{"decision_id":"6e56cb3e93138e96356c-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"提供 Nmap 掃描指令，並解說開放連接埠的服務探測流程。","evidence":"# nmap -sSV -T4 -F -d --version-trace insecure.org"}]}
